title: The Long Man of Wilmington, South Downs, UK - The Long Man of Wilmington Dawn Chorus
author: Curtis James
notes: Dawn chorus, early phase (recording starts 04:15, 30 May 2021), Long Man of Wilmington, South Downs, East Sussex, England (Curtis James, LOM Mikro USI mics, typically very low-noise). title: The Long Man of Wilmington, South Downs, UK - The Long Man of Wilmington Dawn Chorus
author: Curtis James
notes: Dawn chorus, full phase (~04:43) from the same Wilmington recording as chorus-1, so perspective/level match for crossfades. Denser and fuller (blackbird/song thrush fluting at 1.5-2.5 kHz very present). A few soft <150 Hz wind puffs (~-62 dBFS, ~1 s, e.g. near 1810 s) - inaudible after hp=80. -37.7 LUFS raw.

title: in the Forest Garden - Wood pigeon
author: Sophie Standford
notes: Wood pigeon full song: three 'coo-COO-coo, coo-coo' phrases + closing note (~9 s), bird on a nest outside the window, Mid Suffolk, England, Apr 2025, MixPre (FLAC 48k). +27-33 dB over floor at 300-700 Hz. Background has distant songbirds and LF rumble: use hp=200, lp=2500. Each file is a whole song (longer than other shots) - wood pigeons sing in such multi-phrase bouts.

title: Am Rohrbusch, Lübars, Berlin, Germany - Rooster
author: Peter Stets
notes: Rooster crow (~2 s 'cock-a-doodle-doo', 0.5-3 kHz harmonics) in a garden, Lubars, Berlin, Germany, Feb 2025 (FLAC 48k). Clean (+29-35 dB), faint sparrows behind. Two crow styles present (two birds or variants). Region note: German, not UK - domestic chickens are the same everywhere; no clean UK/Irish cockerel exists on archive.org (only one buried in a thunderstorm recording). Engine places it 120
